title: Detailed spinning top
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='45%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b9d'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#e63c78'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a81f52'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stripeGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f0b400'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='handleGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8fd3ff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#e8f6ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5fb4ec'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- handle stem -->
  <rect x='46' y='8' width='8' height='16' rx='4' fill='url(#handleGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='8' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#bfe7ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='8' rx='3.5' ry='2.4' fill='#5fb4ec'/>

  <!-- top disc / shoulder -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='24' rx='16' ry='5' fill='#ff8fb5'/>
  <rect x='34' y='24' width='32' height='6' fill='#e63c78'/>

  <!-- upper body cone -->
  <path d='M34 30 Q34 46 19 62 Q16 66 16 70 L84 70 Q84 66 81 62 Q66 46 66 30 Z' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- yellow stripe band -->
  <path d='M23 55 Q50 49 77 55 L75 61 Q50 55 25 61 Z' fill='url(#stripeGrad)'/>

  <!-- highlight on body -->
  <path d='M40 34 Q42 44 34 56 Q38 47 38 34 Z' fill='#ffb3cc' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M43 32 Q45 40 40 50' stroke='#ffd9e4' stroke-width='2' fill='none' opacity='0.7' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- lower rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='34' ry='8' fill='#c42e63'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='34' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fb5' stroke-width='1.6'/>

  <!-- little dots on rim -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='71' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='74' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='75.5' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='74' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='71' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- bottom spindle point -->
  <path d='M42 76 Q50 96 50 96 Q50 96 58 76 Z' fill='#8fd3ff'/>
  <path d='M47 76 Q50 90 50 90 Q50 90 50 76 Z' fill='#e8f6ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='95' r='2.4' fill='#5fb4ec'/>

  <!-- spin motion swirls -->
  <path d='M14 44 Q6 40 10 50' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M86 44 Q94 40 90 50' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M9 58 Q2 55 6 64' stroke='#ff8fb5' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M91 58 Q98 55 94 64' stroke='#ff8fb5' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
